goal_questions.question: Which physical defect caused an observed operational failure mode?
Which component is affected by the physical defect causing a reported failure mode?
Which catalog product contains the defective component causing a reported failure mode?
Which catalog product incorporates a component reported to have a physical defect?
Which finished product directly exhibits a reported physical defect?

entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: Finished furniture item offered in the catalog, excluding individual structural parts or replacement hardware.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: Individual structural part, hardware element, or material piece of a furniture product, excluding complete finished catalog products.

entity_types.name: Defect
entity_types.description: Specific physical flaw, manufacturing imperfection, material damage, or dimensional flaw, excluding functional failure symptoms and subjective styling preferences.

entity_types.name: FailureMode
entity_types.description: Functional malfunction, operational failure, or assembly breakdown experienced during product use or assembly, excluding underlying physical material flaws.

fact_types.description: Connects an observed operational failure mode, functional malfunction, or assembly problem to the underlying physical defect that caused it.
Connects a reported physical flaw, manufacturing error, or damage to the specific component part exhibiting it.
Connects an observed physical flaw, surface damage, or defect directly to the finished catalog product.
Links an individual component mentioned in a review to the catalog product that the review document is about.
